Four agents that choose alike under ordinary conditions, corrigible resolve (R), entrenchment (E), imposed protection (P) and inertia (I), meet a defeater or an irrelevant change of matched size, onset and duration, at three commitment ages, and are ablated four ways at the onset on identical observation streams.
